test.name: Set record_persona_id on assertions from a record_search result
test.description: Converted from ut_record_extraction_006; extraction runs in code. Extract assertions from a record_search result handed over by search-records. Because the record came from record_search (logged as log_001 with a results sidecar), each assertion must carry record_persona_id — the GedcomX person id of its persona within the result's gedcomx — and the persisted record_id must be the stored form in the sidecar of the assertion's own log entry (extraction_append reads the record and logs that read, so here the ARK it was read by). The focus persona's record_persona_id must equal the result's primaryId.

input.user_message: Extract FamilySearch record ark:/61903/1:1:MXHY-TP4, which search-records found and logged as log_001.

judge_context: Override for Correctness and Completeness: the test chooses which record the skill extracts. Do not lower any score because the record concerns people the project objective does not name.

The skill makes one extraction_append call and relays each record's summary verbatim. Grade that call and that relay; the classifications are decided in code and are checked by the expected_classifications validator, not by you.
